verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own inbound routing automatically parses and routes incoming emails by rules and webhooks, so a narrow, rule-based automation runs in the background without user action. The Scheduled Messages API covers only one-off scheduled sends, not recurring schedules, and webhooks are notification building blocks rather than automations. missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, recurring or triggered multi-step automations, agent-driven autonomous execution, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of background automation behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automatically parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks.
Keep track of scheduled messages using MailerSend's Scheduled Messages API endpoint.
